name: dl-terrain-diversity
description: DL-TerrainDiversity — a Terrain Design Information Model (TDIM). A terrain analysis instrument; not a prediction.
author: Digital Landscapes (Marc-Eduard Ihle)
//: NO "type" FIELD ON PURPOSE. Declaring "module" makes every .js in this package ESM, which breaks tools/abstract-docx.js — it uses require(). It is also unnecessary: the ESM entry points are all .mjs (static/_selftest.mjs, tools/*.mjs) and static/*.js are loaded by the browser via <script type="module">, which never consults this file. node --check will NOT catch the breakage; it only parses.

scripts.figures: node tools/poster-circles.mjs && node tools/poster-axo.mjs && node tools/poster-png.mjs
